scope: Website app-lock continuity on same-tab reload
testEnvironment: Real Chromium, production application in React StrictMode, mocked API responses and background/elapsed-time events
limitations: No live production deployment or account access
No physical iPhone or Safari device test
behavior: Same-tab genuine reload preserves a verified unlocked account
Initial server session and lock status are still checked
Locked reload, new tab, ordinary navigation, logout, changed account and invalid status do not inherit unlock
Delayed initial lock status and late responses preserve newer lock/authentication decisions
storage: One-use non-secret sessionStorage handoff and localStorage authentication generation; no PIN or biometric secret is stored
